name: lysosome
description: Agents that clean up after themselves: notices the git worktrees Claude Code sessions leave behind, reports what is safe to reclaim, and (opt-in) tidies merged ones when the session ends. Uses the lysosome CLI, whose safety rules decide what may go.

auto_tidy.title: Tidy up when a session ends
auto_tidy.description: off (default): only notice and report. strip-merged: when the session's worktree is clean and merged, move its git-ignored build output and dependencies to the Trash and keep the worktree. remove-merged: also remove the worktree itself (git worktree remove; the branch is kept). REVIEW worktrees are never touched.
